summary.text: Jeff Magrum is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 8 (home city listed as Hazelton), serving from 2017 to 2022 in the House and since 2023 in the Senate per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Magrum lists an occupation of Self Employed, Businessman; Rancher.
It lists education as Environmental Systems; NDSCS; Licensed Master Plumber; Licensed pump and pitless unit contractor.
It also lists ND Class A contractor, Beaver Valley Horse Club, Voices for Lake Oahe, Emmons County Farm Bureau, Past Mayor, City of Hazelton and Past Emmons County Commissioner.
Family is listed as: Married (Donna); 2 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Magrum's standing committee assignments as Appropriations and Appropriations - Human Resources Division.
